rows.text: Norges Bank's Executive Board decided to keep the key policy rate unchanged at 1.5 percent.
Norges Bank's Executive Board decided to keep the key policy rate unchanged at 1.5 percent.
"Overall developments in the Norwegian economy have been broadly in line with expectations.
"Overall developments in the Norwegian economy have been broadly in line with expectations.
The key policy rate has therefore been left unchanged", says Deputy Governor Jan F. Qvigstad.
